summary: A Yes vote levies a $148 per parcel tax in the Cambrian School District for eight years.

tax.text: A Yes vote levies a $148-per-parcel annual tax for eight years and provides about $1,000,000 annually for district academic programs.
tax.quote: A "YES" vote APPROVES funding to protect the District's academic classroom programs and avoids cuts.

schools.text: A Yes vote provides local funding for core academic programs, teachers, and classroom instruction in Cambrian School District schools.
schools.quote: Measure Q is a local parcel tax on the November 3, 2026 ballot, seeking voter authorization to provide stable funding to protect core academic programs and prevent further budget reductions at CSD neighborhood schools.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the parcel tax and does not provide the measure's proposed funding for district programs.
tax.quote: A "YES" vote APPROVES funding to protect the District's academic classroom programs and avoids cuts.

schools.text: A No vote rejects the measure's funding, leaving district programs subject to the reductions identified by the school district.
